Conductor is Retell's AI assistant for building agents, investigating conversations, and improving analytics dashboards. Ask for what you need in plain language, attach relevant context, and review proposed changes before applying them.
Ask Conductor to change your agent's prompts, settings, or conversation flow in plain language. It proposes edits for you to review before applying them.
Conductor can run simulation tests that play out a scenario against your agent and show how it responds. This lets you check changes without making real phone calls.
Conductor can inspect your knowledge bases, their source metadata, and indexing status. Attach a knowledge base or name it in your request to find its sources and understand how it is configured.
Investigate calls and chats with Retell AI Conductor. Filter conversations, inspect transcripts and tool calls, and compare failures to find agent improvements.
Ask Conductor to build an analytics dashboard or improve one you already use. Describe what you want to measure, then review its proposed changes before applying them.
Conductor can inspect AI QA cohorts, aggregate results, and individual call evaluations. Ask it to explain a trend or examine the calls behind a low score.
Conductor can find contacts, inspect their fields, and review their associated phone calls and SMS chats. Use it to understand a contact's history across agents.
Three settings decide how your agent sounds and behaves before you write a word of prompt: the language model, the voice, and who speaks first.
Configure the End Call tool in Retell AI to hang up when a conversation is complete and send optional custom SIP headers with call outcomes or reference IDs.
Add the Transfer Call tool to a Retell single or multi-prompt agent to route calls to a human, with cold, warm, and agentic warm transfer modes.
Use the Send SMS tool so a Retell single or multi-prompt agent can text the caller or another number mid-call from SMS-enabled Retell or imported numbers.
Enable Retell single or multi-prompt agents to navigate DTMF-input IVR menus by pressing keypad digits during outbound calls to reach the right department.
Add a custom function to a Retell single- or multi-prompt agent to call your API mid-call. Configure URL, method, headers, parameters, and responses.
The AI contradicted itself when layering conditionals - it got confused about morning vs afternoon time, kept asking to repeat despite correct answers being given.
Tried to book an appointment 3 weeks out - it acknowledged that but could not confirm exact date/time. Still impressed overall.

Voice sounds great, but: told it unavailable until next year, it confirmed Feb 4th 'next year' but thought current year was 2022. Also got stuck in a loop saying 'let me double check your records' then falsely claimed disconnection.

I tried the demo, and it got confused and disconnected, but it's a cool proof of concept. Suggest bumping up the happiness emotion on the agent, and a Calendly integration would immediately unlock a lot of use cases.

It's really good, but the AI cracks still show up. Trying the demo therapist, it suggested finding a career counsellor and said it would 'get back' or was 'working on it' - but it clearly doesn't understand what it's saying, claiming to do tasks it can't.
This is absolutely wild - I got chills when I thought about the fact I'm talking to a computer. Congratulations on flying straight over uncanny valley.
Curious what model the dentist bot is running on? Tried it out, was surprisingly good, though eventually it contradicted itself (booked a slot it said previously was not available).
I tried to fool the Dental Office demo trying to book on Sunday or outside of the slots it had indicated, and it did a better job than many humans would have.
BTW I don't think the demo works on mobile, tried it on Safari on iOS and got no response.
Founder (yanyan_evie) noted voice provider costs differ: 'The different providers have different prices. openai tts & deepgram are cheaper, 11labs are higher.'

Founder clarified positioning vs Vocode: 'If you have your own LLM, our feature is the most customizable... we don't have any integrations, we only focus on the voice AI API part and leave the LLM part to customer.'
Founder said multilingual support is on roadmap: 'It's definitely in our roadmap. After the core product—the voice AI part—becomes humanlike enough, we will support multilingual capabilities.'
A commenter noted per-minute pricing (17¢/min) could be exploited: a malicious caller could keep the bot on the line for hours across many parallel lines, running up a large bill for the business.

Thread titled 'Retellai won't delete my credit card' - a user complained the company would not delete their stored credit card; commenters suggested disputing via bank or filing BBB/California consumer affairs complaints.
In a discussion of open-source alternatives to VAPI/Retell AI, one user noted: 'Livekit feels more or less for media handling then building voice agent. Last i checked retellai was using livekit.'
